nodes.label: FastAPI ASGI Adapter
nodes.description: FastAPI app with async /ask endpoint (httpx-based). In-process rate limiter (20/min). Mounts Flask WSGI app for legacy routes. Extracts Clerk JWT from Authorization header

nodes.label: search_wikipedia
nodes.description: Fetches Wikipedia summary via REST v1 API. Caches with TTL=600s, max 256 entries. Returns title + 300-char extract

nodes.label: get_daily_study
nodes.description: Fetches daily calendar items from Sefaria API + Pyluach hebrew date. Returns Rambam, Daf Yomi, Mishnah Yomi with title and ref. Caches 5 min. Graceful fallback to local calendar

nodes.label: get_text(ref)
nodes.description: Fetches text passage with He+En arrays. Tries v3 API first (avoid Cloudflare block), falls back to v2 with full candidate resolution. Returns lines with path-based alignment

nodes.label: search_customs
nodes.description: Keyword and fuzzy matching across in-memory customs. Returns matches with community, topic, ruling, source, notes, media_url

nodes.label: Customs Data Loader
nodes.description: Loads all JSON files from customs/ folder. Normalizes varied JSON shapes (simple dict vs structured with halacha_index). Caches with signature-based change detection

nodes.label: Flask App (app.py)
nodes.description: Main Flask WSGI application. Owns: bootstrapping, cache/session, public web routes, JSON API routes, Supabase/Clerk integration, ShelahEngine instantiation

nodes.label: SIDDUR_SECTION_MAP
nodes.description: Maps prayer names (Upon Arising, Weekday Shacharit, etc.) to Siddur Sefard section refs for full text retrieval

nodes.label: search_halachipedia
nodes.description: MediaWiki API search on halachipedia.com. Two-step: search for title, then extract intro. Caches results with TTL=600s

nodes.label: _retrieve_community_knowledge
nodes.description: Retrieves top RAG rows from Supabase community_knowledge table using keyword extraction + community filter + scoring. Fallback behavior when text filter too restrictive

nodes.label: Vercel Routing Config
nodes.description: Routes all requests to asgi.py. Simple catch-all: /(.*)  ->  asgi.py

nodes.label: ShelahEngine
nodes.description: Service facade aggregating zmanim, sefaria texts, customs, search. Single entry point for app.py and asgi.py route handlers. Initializes with lat/lon/timezone

nodes.label: _JSONFormatter
nodes.description: Structured JSON logging. Emits single-line JSON per log record with timestamp, level, logger, message, module, function, line, exception (if present)

nodes.label: Sefaria Library (Cached)
nodes.description: Structured cached interface to Sefaria full text library. Features: memory + disk cache (7d TTL), blocking status tracking, v3 + v2 API fallback, library index pruning

nodes.label: APIHealth Circuit Breaker
nodes.description: Thread-safe in-process circuit breaker for Sefaria, Hebcal, Gemini, Claude. Maintains per-service state: up/down/half-open with FAIL_THRESHOLD=3, RECOVERY_INTERVAL=120s
